purpose: State the role, capacity, or status in which someone acts.
keywords: Noun + として; noun + としての + noun
I took part in the meeting as an interpreter.
I will keep this as a memento.
I feel my responsibility as a parent.
formation: Noun + として; noun + としての + noun
restrictions: Names a role rather than an individual’s personal perspective.
mistake: にとって means from someone’s viewpoint; として means in a capacity.
